text:
olivia_sales: Hey team — Meridian (prospect) just handed us a SIG v3.0 request, they want question-by-question evidence and an index. Deadline: Mon EOD. Need owners for Q1-Q20. Can we triage? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

diego_se: I can take Q1-Q5 (networking, perimeter controls, vuln mgmt). Will gather configs and scan reports.

sarah_security: I'll cover identity & access (Q6-Q9) and key management (Q10). FYI, anything with secrets must go to secure artifacts only, do not paste creds. :no_entry_sign:

olivia_sales: Thanks. Can we keep the response to one shared index file + direct links to artifacts (S3/Drive) and a short note per question saying where the evidence lives? Meridian prefers direct links.

jess_ops: I can provision a protected S3 folder and put a short README for each question. Naming convention: meridian-sig/ques-01_q5/README.md etc. I'll also enable object-level logging for audit.

alex_product: Heads-up: Q12 asks about model access logging and tokenization handling — will need a short technical note from runtime team (diego?).

diego_se: Yep. I'll draft a 2-paragraph explanation and attach the runtime audit log sample.

olivia_sales: Great. Let's capture status in this thread. Quick triage table (short):
Q1: diego_se — network ACLs + Nmap scan link
Q2: diego_se — firewall rules + fw-audit.pdf
Q3: diego_se — WAF config + waf-rules.json
Q4: diego_se — vulnerability scan + nessus-report-2026-03.pdf
Q5: diego_se — patch policy summary
Q6: sarah_security — RBAC matrix + idp-sso-screenshots.png
Q7: sarah_security — service account rotation proof + ssm-rotation-log.txt
Q8: sarah_security — MFA enforcement policy
Q9: sarah_security — SAML metadata + audit trail
Q10: sarah_security — KMS key rotation schedule + kms-rotation.csv
Q11: jess_ops — backup retention doc
Q12: diego_se — model access logs + sample-trace.json
Q13: jess_ops — incident response playbook excerpt
Q14: jess_ops — DR test report
Q15: alex_product — data handling policy + pseudonymization note
Q16: alex_product — model fine-tune controls
Q17: ops & sec — deployment pipeline hardening
Q18: sarah_security — vulnerability disclosure process
Q19: diego_se — container images SBOM link
Q20: jess_ops — SLA and uptime history

sarah_security: Minor note — for Q7/10 the customer wants a signed attestation for rotation cadence. I can generate a template attestation, but legal needs to review. @olivia_sales loop in legal?

olivia_sales: Yup, I'll ping legal now and add them to the doc for sign-off.

evidence-bot: New protected bucket created: s3://redwood-evidence/meridian-sig-1845678901/ — upload link expires in 7d.

jess_ops: Uploaded initial artifacts for Q1-Q5 and README drafts: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-evidence/meridian-sig-1845678901?prefix=

diego_se: Dropping sample command for pulling logs (redacted):
``
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-evidence/meridian-sig-1845678901/q12/runtime-audit-sample.json ./
jq '.events[] | {ts,user,event}' runtime-audit-sample.json
``

sarah_security: Added RBAC matrix and rotation attest template to the bucket. Tagging: "for-legal-review".

olivia_sales: Meridian asked if we can provide a CSV index mapping SIG question -> artifact link (they auto-ingest). Can someone export a two-column CSV? e.g., question_id,url

jess_ops: I'll produce the CSV and attach to root README. ETA: today by 5pm PT.

alex_product: Also confirm redaction policy in README: we will supply excerpts and logs with IP/host redacted unless customer requests full logs via secure channel. Meridian ok?

olivia_sales: They said initial ingestion should be the redacted set; full logs can be shared after NDA extension.

diego_se: Quick blocker: Q3 wants WAF rule history for last 12 months. We have logs but need to pull older snapshots from archive (takes a day). Marking Q3 as in-progress.

olivia_sales: Good call. Update the CSV status column with in-progress where needed.

sarah_security: Legal replied: will review attestation template; expect comments tomorrow.

jess_ops: CSV uploaded: s3://redwood-evidence/meridian-sig-1845678901/meridian-sig-index.csv. It contains question_id,url,status,owner.

olivia_sales: Perfect — I'll send a brief note to Meridian with the index and explain redaction + next steps. Drafting message now.

diego_se: One more tech note for Q12: runtime logs include user_id hashes; include example mapping note explaining one-way hashing approach.

olivia_sales: Thanks everyone. Action items:
- diego_se: finish Q1-Q5 artifacts + runtime note (today)
- sarah_security: finalize attestation template + Q6-Q10 (tomorrow)
- jess_ops: finalize CSV and upload missing READMEs (today 5pm PT)
- alex_product: short policy blurbs for Q15-Q16 (tomorrow)
- olivia_sales: send index to Meridian once CSV + README are in place

olivia_sales: If anything slips, call it out here. Huge win if we can get this done by Monday. :crossed_fingers:
